_doc: #296 day-one frontline seed. Three fixed body-type slots (1 SUV / 1 truck / 1 sedan) so the player can match some walk-in from minute one. Each slot draws a value-banded template from its category — `candidateTrials` deterministic draws (template x condition x year x mileage), the first whose live retail lands in [targetRetail*(1-tolerancePct), targetRetail*(1+tolerancePct)] wins (closest-to-target if none land in band) — so total starting equity barely moves between saves. Condition is capped to clean/average (never rough) and units ship recon-complete: no hidden-lemon tail in the starter set. Only make/year/mileage vary for flavor.
